responsibility: This definition module declares the ARRAY OF CHAR interface for accessing a program’s command-line arguments in GNU Modula-2. It belongs to the runtime argument subsystem and exposes GetArg to copy the nth argv entry into a caller buffer and Narg to report argc, defining the stable procedural API used by higher-level argument and option modules.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the Args pair: it publishes the GetArg and Narg signatures for argv access, while Args.mod contains the UnixArgs-based implementation that copies argument bytes and appends ASCII nul.
